svg.title: When a duplicate that the AI found closes on its own
svg.desc: A duplicate that the AI is sure of, of an older open issue, gets the notice that closes it after three days only when a maintainer opened the original or triaged it, so that it no longer has needs-triage. Otherwise it becomes a suggestion for the maintainer and a related issue in the comment. A notice closes nothing when someone comments, when the reporter or anyone who may push to the repository reacts with a thumbs down, or when the original is closed or no longer vouched for by then.
